notes.title: Performance & Lighting Update
notes.content: We improved the lighting for better performance and cleaned up a few map issues.  Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Various Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where lobbies were being split by both language and region. Lobbies are now matched by region only, allowing more players to connect together.

Added med kits to more maps 

Cleaned up Wizard's Wacky World Pet Card Achievements

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Performance Boost & Gameplay Polish!
notes.content: [p]We’ve made key improvements to enhance your experience in [i]Escape Toon Kingdom[/i]. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Improved performance on lower-end computers for smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Refined head bob and player movement for a more comfortable experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced translation quality for better communication across languages[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted maps to better support player navigation and gameplay flow[/p][/*][*][p]General quality-of-life upgrades to make your adventure even more enjoyable[/p][/*][/list][p]Update now and dive back in—the Toon Kingdom just got a whole lot smoother.[/p]

notes.title: Wizard's Wacky World Quick Patch!
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Minor map changes to Wizard's Wacky World. [/p][/*][*][p]Added better instruction for levitation wand areas. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where DJ Bunny Boss Battle wasn't taking damage.

notes.title: The wait is over! Neon Nexus is now OPEN!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241358/dc8e3c602d4859c2044dec1e4652fac12a9df7e5.png[/img]

Dance ‘til you drop—literally. Solve puzzles, explore immersive worlds, and battle friends in high-stakes showdowns.

Race futuristic bikes to claim victory.
Drift through zero gravity… but are you alone?
Face DJ Bunny in the ultimate dance battle.

Neon Nexus is thrilling, terrifying, and endlessly fun. Are you ready to play?

notes.title: Voting Results are in!
notes.content:
Voting Results Are In! 

The votes have been counted, and Neon Nexus takes the win!  Thanks to strong support from our community, Neon Nexus has officially won the popular vote as the next world to enter development. We’ve already begun bringing it to life, so stay tuned for sneak peeks and updates as we go!

 Join our Discord for exclusive behind-the-scenes updates, teasers, and to become a part of our awesome community. We’d love to hear your ideas, feedback, and more as we shape Neon Nexus together. Don’t miss out—see you there!

notes.title: Welcome to Toyland: The Grand Reveal
notes.content:
Welcome to Toyland, the most exciting chapter in our game yet! Explore magical landscapes, solve puzzles, and face thrilling challenges in this new update.

Roll the dice in Sugar Rush Hills, a life-sized game board full of surprises. Escape the giant dollhouse in Dolly’s Dreamland—if you can avoid her grasp. Or race against time in the Fuzzy Friend Factory, where assembling your own teddy bear takes a terrifying turn.

With fresh gameplay, stunning visuals, and unforgettable adventures, Toyland is a journey you won’t want to miss.

Are you ready to play?

[previewyoutube=kz6UNsPIaX0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
